exposure: Surgical interventions (e.g., subtotal colectomy with ileostomy)
cohort: A cohort of 57 babies admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit with Bell's stage 3b necrotizing enterocolitis.
finding: At 1 year post-surgery, 72% of babies with Bell's stage 3b NEC were alive and thriving, despite high rates of short bowel syndrome, failure to thrive, and developmental delay.
